svg.text: $ per million tokens, input + output, averaged over the measured workloads (routing, prompt optimisation) · filled = node at Scan list price, 70% utilisation
API, market-median provider price, same mix, cached input at its own price; at its measured accuracy where run
API, cheapest tier: a promotion (4 of 23 GLM providers) or FP4 resellers (DeepSeek)
frontier: nothing is both cheaper and better
* quality from the same weights and kernels in another layout; own run not made
